race.comment: HARMONIC DANCER (13) looks the clear top pick. Went back from a wide gate fresh but can with a huge run to finish runner-up here over 1050m. Fitter and drawn ideally. Can go one better. BRIMARVI ROSEMARIE (7) has been racing well without winning, the latest a fast-finishing second here in a Class 2. Overdue and should be winding up late again. GOLDEN CLOUD (8) was an impressive maiden winner fresh and has good upside. Just missed here when second-up last time in. SUNDOGG (17) goes very well fresh and nicely weighted with the claim. STEEL TSUNAMI (12) was well off best on the Parks track last time. Has the ability and capable of sharp improvement.
